learning_objective: 🎯 Understand the guardian of the Constitution! Learn how courts protect our rights, interpret laws, and maintain the rule of law independently.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: For courts to be fair, they must be free from pressure by the executive or legislature. Judges have security of tenure, their salaries cannot be reduced, and they can only be removed through a very tough impeachment process.

India has a single integrated judicial system. At the top is the Supreme Court, followed by High Courts in states, and District/Subordinate courts below them. Supreme Court decisions bind all other courts.
It has Original (disputes between Centre and States), Appellate (appeals from High Courts), Advisory (advising the President), and Writ (protecting Fundamental Rights) jurisdictions.
The power of the Supreme Court and High Courts to examine the constitutionality of any law or executive order. If it violates the Constitution, the court can strike it down.

Through Public Interest Litigation (PIL), courts allow anyone to file cases on behalf of the poor and oppressed. The judiciary has taken an active role in expanding rights (like a clean environment as part of the Right to Life).

fun_activity.title: 📢 Write a PIL
fun_activity.instructions: Is there a highly polluted lake or a dangerous road crossing in your town? Draft a 5-sentence 'Public Interest Litigation' addressed to the Chief Justice, asking for action to protect citizens' right to safe living!

exam_tips: 📌 Be ready to explain how the independence of the judiciary is secured in the Constitution (appointment, removal, salaries).
📌 Distinguish between Original, Appellate, and Advisory jurisdiction.
📌 Analyze the pros and cons of Judicial Activism (protects rights but sometimes steps into the executive's domain).
quick_recap: ⭐ Judges to the Supreme Court and High Courts are appointed through the Collegium system.
⭐ The Supreme Court is the ultimate interpreter of the Constitution.
⭐ A PIL can be filed even based on a simple postcard or newspaper report.
